maintainerRevisions.description: Flush-face fix by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code (2026-11-12). MonitorRearChamber: boxGeo 0.420x0.180x0.588 -> 0.412x0.180x0.580 so its sides are 4 mm inside the bezel frame sides; MonitorSafetyGlass: moved 4 mm further out along the screen normal (offset 0.016 -> 0.020 sin, 0.012 cos) off the CRT and bezel inner front faces; SideArt_R/L: art geometry inset about 4 mm (scaled 0.452/0.46 x 1.292/1.30 about its centre) so its edge no longer lies on the border edge; CoinReturnPocket_R/L: depth 0.024 -> 0.022, centre x 0.278 -> 0.279 so the back face is 2 mm inside the door inner back plane; front face unchanged; RearCasterBracket_R/L: width 0.040 -> 0.036, centre x -0.34 -> -0.338 so the back face is 4 mm in from the cabinet floor back face
